title: Retained official reads behind the 2026-11-18 pack
rule: A read file in this pack is immutable history. This manifest is the fingerprint; tools/verify_2026_11_18_55c364b6.py re-hashes every file against it on every build.

files.describes: Week 11 slate: 13 fixtures, 6 byes, kickoff slots, networks, event labels
files.method: rendered read of the live official page through the agent's fetch tool; not raw HTTP bytes. The raw-bytes path in this repository is the CI ledger (.github/workflows/injury-ledger.yml -> data/ledger/injuries/), which keeps gzipped responses. Both are recorded as what they are. Since 2026-11-18T04:20Z the pack also carries the whole-report comparison against those retained bytes (injuries_raw_2026-11-18.json / _rows_2026-11-18.tsv, written by tools/verify_injuries_from_raw.py), so the rendered reads above are no longer the only evidence that the published table matches the page - they remain the evidence for the Week 11 slate, which the ledger does not fetch.
